exposure: fetal diagnosis of a life-limiting condition
threatened preterm labour at the limits of viability
outcome: NICU team's involvement in perinatal palliative care (PPC)
frequency PPC was offered, accepted, and received for live births
cohort: The study participants were patients with a prenatal diagnosis of a life-limiting condition or threatened preterm labour at the limits of viability, born live between January 2010 and January 2020.
finding: The study found that perinatal palliative care (PPC) was offered to a minority of families with a life-limiting condition (15%) or threatened preterm labour (31%) who experienced a live birth, though shared decision-making was well-documented when consults involved decision-making (90% for LLC, 87% for TPTL).
